No, the second chance protection is for your body as a whole. The first hit that would normally kill you in one go (if there is one) will not be counted (or at least it shouldn’t be)

My testing:

I ran Factory a couple of times, testing each setting one raid at a time.

I used the same account that I debug on, with only my mod installed:

Second chance protection: Unclear, I did take a black Thorax but I was told you only die from this if you also succumb to a bleed. Requires further testing, but I took a pretty hard hit and didn’t go down.

Keep 1 Health (All selected): Worked very well. None of my limbs blacked, and and I toggled the “Ignore side effects” feature after I received a fracture. It healed in a few seconds. I was shot at by two guys, my hit registered on both of them. Headshots on both, they hit me and I hit them:

% Damage Received: Worked pretty well I’d say. I’m no maths dude, but this was after I tanked two full mags of SKS to the chest and arms and some on the rest of my body. I did not use any other setting. Edit: I was also able to hit him back, and he had audible and visual reactions to the hits. His helmet saved him from most of my headshots, but eventually he caved in and died.

I did have other mods installed during troubleshooting over the past few days (none that affect health anyway), but my results never differed. I couldn’t replicate bots not hitting each other either. I found a couple of dead scavs and pmcs dead after hearing the firefights, and I didn’t kill them.

All in all, since I can’t replicate this issue I don’t know what I should do. But this mod worked well on my 3.7.1 install with fresh profile (all it ever does is run Factory). I can’t say much more than that other than show you what I found when testing just now.

comments.body_html:
correct, I removed it as it turns out the PR author of that feature did not test the feature enough, and it broke the mod. I also did not test it enough, but I didn’t pay attention to the problems it caused. I reverted it to a state where this mod is functional.

*edit: I plan on trying to incorporate it into a standalone mod once I get time.

comments.author: Devraccoon Senior Moderator
comments.body_html: yes, this is due to the fact it’s based on percentage and not a hard bool/integer value, it can never be truly 0 (as far as I’m aware). this is also not designed to be a full on god mode, which means zero damage will never be a thing. it’s designed to function to let damage through with benefits, but not kill you. the slider can be misleading, so I will look into not allowing a minimum of 0% but maybe 1-5%. thanks for reporting though
